hooks.command: kb="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/crv-kb"; if [ ! -d "$kb/.git" ]; then echo "CRV knowledge base not found at ./crv-kb. Ask the user before cloning git@github.com:magnusahmad/crv-kb.git there."; elif ! git -C "$kb" pull --rebase --autostash -q >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "CRV knowledge base at ./crv-kb could not be updated (offline, conflict, or a branch without upstream). It may be stale."; fi; exit 0
